paraphrase: document granting permission for an activity

zh: 从事受监管活动的执照
example: Her commercial driver's license lists the classes of truck she is legally authorized to operate.
paraphrase: official authorization to perform a regulated activity

zh: 证明资格或事实的证书
example: The training provider awarded each graduate a signed certificate of completion bearing the school's official seal.
paraphrase: document formally attesting to an achievement or fact

zh: 经正式评定获得的认证
example: The lab achieved ISO certification from an accredited body after passing its conformity assessment.
paraphrase: formal recognition that requirements have been met

example: Members qualify for the discount as soon as they meet both eligibility conditions; no separate request is needed.
paraphrase: meet the conditions for receiving something

example: After forty years with us, Mei will retire from working life and begin drawing her pension.
paraphrase: leave the workforce at the end of one's career

zh: 工作表现；任务完成质量
example: Her job performance earned top marks for accuracy and speed, although she joined only three weeks ago.
paraphrase: quality of a person's execution of assigned work

example: The panel's evaluation of each candidate includes a score for every item on the checklist.

paraphrase: person responsible for directing a business unit

paraphrase: person chosen to lead an organization

example: As chief financial officer, Maya is the highest-ranking finance executive in the entire organization.

zh: 旅客携带或托运的行李

paraphrase: travelers' bags carried on a journey

example: Boarding begins when the agents open the aircraft door and invite passengers aboard in seat-number order.
paraphrase: process of passengers getting onto a vehicle

example: The workshop fee includes transportation by minibus between the hotel and factory for every registered participant.
paraphrase: movement of people or goods from one place to another

paraphrase: flow of vehicles using a road

paraphrase: period during which access is shut off

example: Complete online registration by entering your name on the attendee list before bookings close.
paraphrase: process of signing up and being officially recorded

zh: 为活动供应餐饮的服务
example: The dinner budget covers catering for eighty guests, including the food, cooks and table service.
paraphrase: service providing food and drinks for an event

zh: 某地区或传统的烹饪风格
example: The restaurant serves coastal cuisine, including local fish cooked in the region's traditional style.
paraphrase: style of cooking associated with a place or tradition

example: On the dinner menu, guests can choose dishes from the starter, main course and dessert sections.
paraphrase: list of food and drink available to order

example: Shall we dine together at the restaurant this evening? Your dinner place has already been set.

paraphrase: counter where arriving guests receive assistance

zh: 载人或运货的升降电梯

paraphrase: enclosed lift carrying people between floors

example: With the lift out, take the stairs; there are exactly eighteen steps from the pavement to reception.

We'll use the nearby hotel so delegates can walk to the workshop in two minutes.
The site map shows where the station is located; its permanent address is printed beneath the marker.
Where is the new annex situated in relation to the main station? Our site map shows its permanent location.
Our downtown showroom stands in the heart of the city center, opposite the central railway terminus.
paraphrase: in the center of a city

zh: 城市外围的郊区居住区
example: The new branch serves a suburb of Brighton; most residents commute downtown from this outlying neighborhood.
paraphrase: community on the outskirts of a city

zh: 公司设在总部以外的分支办事处
example: Send these contracts to the branch office that represents our company locally and handles all regional applications.
paraphrase: local office subordinate to the headquarters

example: Two engineers will travel abroad next month to inspect our first supplier outside the country.
paraphrase: in or to a foreign country

example: Our global delivery network now serves customers on every inhabited continent.

Winter bookings will decline from forty a week to twelve while the ski lifts are closed.
Use the mileage table to figure the precise allowance owed; enter the calculated amount in the total column.

Extra training should address the billing mistakes by teaching clerks how to prevent them.
Our guest will address the assembled delegates from the lectern, speaking for ten minutes before taking questions.
The delivery charge was waived, so the freight line on the invoice shows zero dollars.
Please charge the portable scanner overnight using the cable beside the till.

zh: 扣除已付款项后的余款
example: Pay the outstanding balance of eighty dollars to clear the invoice in full after deducting your deposit.
paraphrase: amount still owed after earlier payments

zh: 把账目核算至借贷平衡
example: The bookkeeper must balance the debit and credit columns by correcting the duplicate entry before closing the ledger.
The fund bought common stock in the supplier and now owns three percent of its outstanding shares.
paraphrase: ownership interest represented by company shares

File the signed receipts in date order, with the oldest document first.
paraphrase: sequence in which items are arranged

Higher freight charges account for most of the increase in our delivery costs.
Please position the screen by moving it two meters to the left of the lectern.

paraphrase: view held on a specific matter

example: The oak's lowest branch now touches the sign; please ask the grounds team to trim it.
Two service roads branch off the highway like the arms of a fork at the distribution center.
paraphrase: split away from a main route

example: Please book two adjoining rooms for next Friday under the convention rate; no reservation has been made yet.

zh: 把收入或支出登记入账
example: The repair expense belongs in April; please book it in the ledger under maintenance costs.
paraphrase: enter a transaction in the accounts

example: We've borrowed the illustrated book on bridge design from the library's engineering collection.
Reserve the front row for the interpreters by blocking those seats in the booking system.
paraphrase: set aside for a specific user or purpose

example: We kept a cash reserve to cover wages if the client paid late.
paraphrase: resource held back for future need

Our sales team booked a booth at the regional furniture fair in September.
We sincerely appreciate your unpaid help; thank you for taking the evening shift at such short notice.

The travel grant should cover both train fares and accommodation for the visiting speaker.
Could you cover my shift by working the counter in my place while I'm at the dentist?
paraphrase: work temporarily in someone else's place

zh: 保护物品的罩子或外盖
example: Lift the protective cover off the scanner glass before scanning; otherwise the entire page will look black.
paraphrase: layer or lid protecting something underneath

zh: 把物品归还给原持有者
example: Please return the borrowed projector to reception before the final group leaves.
paraphrase: give something back to its owner

example: The investment paid a five-percent return last year, adding five dollars to each hundred originally invested.

zh: 合同或任期的持续时间
example: The agreement has a fixed term of three years, after which the entire lease expires.
paraphrase: period for which an agreement lasts

example: Which technical term should we use for this fault? Please copy its name exactly as printed in the manual.
paraphrase: word or expression used in a particular field

example: Either party may cancel this contract by giving the other thirty days' written notice.
paraphrase: person or organization entering an agreement

Since buying the bakery, the sisters run it themselves, hiring staff and managing its finances.
Fifty identical posters came off the press in our first production run before we stopped to check the colors.
paraphrase: batch made in one continuous operation

example: With the replacement belt installed, the press can run through the entire night shift.
Applications for the vacant post of night supervisor close at noon tomorrow.
Please post the evacuation notice beside the time clock, pinning it where every employee will see it.
Please post the signed originals to our branch using the prepaid envelope provided.
Our new line of desk lamps includes three sizes in the same brushed finish.
paraphrase: range of related goods sold together

zh: 排队等候的人或车的队列
example: A line formed outside the shop before the doors opened for its clearance sale.
paraphrase: queue of people waiting their turn

example: Please stay on the line while I transfer your call to our regional office.
Our analyst will present the audited results to the board by showing each chart and explaining the totals.
paraphrase: formally show or explain to an audience

May I wrap this scarf as a birthday present? There's a gift card inside for the shop's founder.
I slipped a handwritten note under your door asking you to call the courier before noon.
Please note the revised closing time before arranging any evening collections.
paraphrase: pay attention to a stated detail

example: Our board of directors voted seven to two to approve the expansion at its quarterly meeting.
Please tell reception if you notice a change in the color of your printed badge.
Please plant these six bare-root saplings in the empty beds, burying each root ball at the marked depth.
paraphrase: put a living plant into soil

example: The retiring chair will tender her resignation at the next board meeting.
The evening shuttle should benefit late-shift staff by cutting their journey home in half.
Please raise the screen from waist height to eye level; the audience cannot see it behind the lectern.
paraphrase: move something to a higher position

example: We expect the first linen jackets to reach our shops in early spring.
The pen's small spring pushes the refill back inside whenever you press the cap.
paraphrase: elastic mechanical component providing a restoring force

example: The parking fine is payable to the city for leaving the van across a marked fire exit.
paraphrase: monetary penalty for breaking a rule

example: The fine mesh has twenty openings per centimeter, twice as many as the coarse filter beside it.
paraphrase: made of very small or closely spaced elements

example: This is only a draft of the agreement; the final version will follow after the lawyers make corrections.
Please draft our first response from scratch; there is no existing text to print or send.
Keep a written record of each payment until the bank sends its monthly statement.
paraphrase: written or stored account of an event

example: Please record every caller's details in the log so the evening team can return their calls.
The supply contract binds both parties to the agreed price once their authorized representatives sign it.
The seals contract from fifty millimeters to forty-nine when chilled, so we warm them before fitting.

zh: 要求偿付费用的正式申请
example: Submit your travel claim for last week's rail fares before the payroll cutoff.
Present your numbered ticket to claim your suitcase; the clerk will release it only to the matching ticket holder.
paraphrase: collect something as its rightful owner

example: Our gift-wrapping service costs two dollars per parcel; a clerk wraps each purchase while the customer waits.
An engineer will service both lifts on Tuesday to keep their motors in good condition.
Please open the attached file in your spreadsheet program to check the totals in column D.
paraphrase: document or collection of stored information

example: Please file your claim directly with the insurer by submitting the signed form through its claims portal.
paraphrase: formally submit to the responsible office

example: The amount due on the itemized hotel bill includes both room charges and breakfast for all three nights.
We will bill your company directly for the meeting room and projector.
paraphrase: send someone an invoice for payment

example: Several visitors expressed interest in buying the display model and asked us for quotations.
paraphrase: attention or curiosity directed toward something

example: Our savings balance earns interest at a fixed annual percentage rate, paid monthly by the bank.
paraphrase: money earned or charged for the use of funds

example: The remote guests could see every slide but heard no sound through their headphones.
The auditors judged our figures sound after independently confirming every entry and recalculating the totals.

zh: 按单位计算的收费标准
example: The hotel quoted a lower nightly rate for stays of three nights or more.
paraphrase: price charged per unit of time or service

example: Please rate your delivery from one to five stars before closing the feedback form.
Please hold the blue jacket for me without altering it; I'll buy it when I return with my wallet.
paraphrase: keep an item available for someone

example: The committee voted to hold the workshop next Tuesday and authorized staff to welcome participants that morning.
paraphrase: arrange for an event to take place

example: The morning seminar will cover refund policies, staff scheduling and safe cash handling.
paraphrase: include a subject within the scope of a discussion

example: One term in the signed lease, printed under “Duration,” fixes the length of our tenancy at three years.
paraphrase: condition included in a legal agreement
